title: Concept: cookie without SameSite
description: A cookie without SameSite is attached to cross-site navigations and, depending on the browser, to some cross-site subrequests, so another origin can trigger authenticated state changes. Lax and Strict narrow when the cookie travels.
applicability: Any response whose Set-Cookie values are inspected.
risk: Cross-site request forgery against cookie-authenticated actions; LOW severity alone.
